notes.title: Kingdoms of Rhea's remake
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

It is with great pride that we announce the new version of Kingdoms of Rhea!

We have worked a lot to offer you this revisited and greatly improved version.

Here is the new trailer of the game : [previewyoutube=w6JBp-8rdP4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

We launched an [url=https://ulule.com/kingdom-of-rhea/]Ulule [/url]campaign to fund further development of Kingdoms of Rhea. Don't waste another second and help us finish this campaign!

The new version of Kingdoms of Rhea will include the following features:
- Multiplayer
- Crafting weapons / armor
- Mounts
- Character customization
- Dynamic gameplay
- Quests with tree of choice
- NPC companions
- and many other things!

Share Ulule and join our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/XbwfUn2]discord[/url]!

Have a good day !

notes.title: Update 0.0.2.4
notes.content:
News

New Steam trailer
More animations on the troll, he can now switch between two state (peaceful/danger)
New stats into the game (still testing)
French translation is now available (except for the pause in game menu)
Adding and improving the feedbacks of the game (and the gameplay)

Fixes
Improving the troll
Credits modification

notes.title: Update 0.0.2.3 hotfix 3
notes.content:
Improvement on the dodge system
Volume modifications

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.2.3 hotfix 2
notes.content:
Improvement on the dodge system
The ultimate icon cooldown has been moved and you can now see the timer until you can use it again
Numbers of items in the quickslots are now displayed

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.2.3 #hotfix 1
notes.content:
Fixes

The camera no longer turns when the character dies
The character can no longer run and leave the boss’s zone during the cinematic
[b]The dodges are corrected[/b]
The character can no longer move when it blocks
The Osts are now read automatically, if one ends, it restarts automatically

notes.title: Update 0.0.2.3
notes.content:
News :

Tuto box use altars and effects of prayers on each God

Fixes :

Minors bug

notes.title: Update 0.0.2.2 hotfix #3
notes.content:
Remove HUD in cinematics
Escape button can now remove the menu
With a gamepad controller you can now close correctly the altar menu

notes.title: Update 0.0.2.2 hotfix #2
notes.content:
News

A suicide button in the game menu in order to get to the last altar if you are blocked
The game now recognizes whether you are a pc or console player, and will change the tutorial as well as the text according to your platform

Fixes

Dodges are more reactive and follow the direction in which you wish to go
Fixed step number 2 that was dodgy
Minor adjustment on leveldesign
